;BEGIN MUI
if exists SYS:Programs/MUI

   if exists MUI:Libs
      C:assign add LIBS: MUI:Libs
   endif
   if exists MUI:Locale
      C:assign add LOCALE: MUI:Locale

   C:version >nil: exec.library 39
   if not warn
      if exists MUI:Docs
         if exists HELP:dummy ; do not remove
         endif                ; this entry!
         C:assign add HELP: MUI:Docs
      endif
   endif
endif
;END MUI

scripts.content:
;BEGIN Roadshow
If NOT EXISTS S:Network-disabled
  If EXISTS S:Network-Startup
    Execute S:Network-Startup
    Run >NIL: SYS:Rexxc/rx S:NetworkConfig.rexx SYNCTIME
  EndIf
EndIf
;END Roadshow
